instances.overview: This model predicts monthly temperature change values across 247 countries and regions from 1961-2023 using FAOSTAT climate data. Trained on 241k records with XGBoost regression, it captures spatial, seasonal, and temporal trends for climate monitoring and anomaly detection. Intended for researchers and policymakers needing rapid temperature change estimates.
